Res.Caption: Accrual Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account Number to which all Accruals will be posted.

Res.Caption: Cost GL Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account Number to which all Costs will be posted.

Res.Caption: Cost Clearing Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account used for posting multi-period apportionment journals for miscellaneous (non-job) expense.

Res.Caption: Revenue Clearing Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account used for posting multi-period apportionment journals for miscellaneous (non-job) revenue.

Res.Caption: Revenue Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account Number to which all Revenue will be posted.

Res.Caption: WIP GL Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account Number to which all WIP will be posted.

Res.Caption: Expense Group
Res.FullDescription: If Reports by particular Expense Groups are required, attach the Charge Code to that Expense Group.

Res.Caption: Sales Group
Res.FullDescription: If Reports by particular Sales Groups are required, attach the Charge Code to that Sales Group.

Res.Caption: GST Tax ID
Res.FullDescription: The default Tax ID unless specifically overridden by a Tax ID below.

Res.Caption: Withholding Tax ID
Res.FullDescription: If the Current Company is WHT Registered, this field will be enabled. Select or enter the WHT Id applicable to this Charge Code.

Res.Caption: Charge Group
Res.FullDescription: This grouping is used when Autorating. Based on the Incoterm used, this group will decide which party pays the charge.

Res.Caption: Principal or Agent Charge
Res.FullDescription: Is this charge reported to the principal or is it agent only.

Res.Caption: Sub-group
Res.FullDescription: When entered, auto-rating will produce Billing charges for this Charge Code for the matching and applicable Job charges.

Res.Caption: Charge Type
Res.FullDescription: DSB - Disbursement. Where 100% of the Revenue is to be Accrued or no Profit is expected. Can only be used for Job related charges. MRG - Margin. Where there are Cost or Revenue or Both. Can only be used for Job related charges. REV - Revenue. Where there are No Cost involved, pure Revenue only. Can be used for both Job related charges and Non-Job related charges. OVR - Overhead. Where there are No Revenue involved, pure Overhead only. Can be used only for Non-Job related charges. NON – Non-Accruing. Where there are Cost or Revenue or Both. Can only be used for Non-Job related charges. .

Res.Caption: Charge Code
Res.FullDescription: The code for the Charge Code. This will be used when selecting this Charge Code in a form that requires Charge Code selection throughout the system

Res.Caption: Department Filter
Res.FullDescription: Department Codes that will be restricted to this charge code. If multiple Departments are entered separate with comma (,).

Res.Caption: Description
Res.FullDescription: Enter the description. This will be the Default description on both Sales & Cost Invoices – it can be over-ridden for individual Invoices.

Res.Caption: IATA Code
Res.FullDescription: Enter the corresponding IATA Charge Code (if applicable).

Res.Caption: Is Active
Res.FullDescription: Check if the Code is still active, otherwise Uncheck if the Code is no longer applicable. System defaults to Checked. Where a Charge Code is no longer required, the system will not allow the Charge Code to be deleted because there are transactions.

Res.Caption: Consol Level Charge
Res.FullDescription: Tick this if the charge code is a Consol Level Charge - i.e. should be costed at the consol level. This should usually only be ticked for Loading, Freight and Unloading charges.

Res.Caption: Local Language Description
Res.FullDescription: Sales invoices for local clients will be printed with Local Language Descriptions. You can disable this behavior by changing the registry “Accounting > Job Invoicing > Enable Local Charge Code Description Default”, in which case the charge description will print in the language of the invoice.

Res.Caption: Margin Percentage
Res.FullDescription: If the Charge Code Type is set to “MRG” then the Trigger can be set to any required percentage. Where a cost is expected when a revenue is charged, set the relevant percentage in reference to the revenue. E.g. if a cost estimated at 80% of the Revenue, set the margin (%) to 80%. Where a cost is not expected when a revenue is charged or vice versa, set the margin (%) to 0%. If the Charge Code is ‘DSB’, it will be preset to 100% and cannot be changed. The default is 100%.

Res.Caption: Rate Calculator
Res.FullDescription: Specifies the default Rating Calculator that will be used when this charge code is used in Quotations, Rating and Autorating.

Res.Caption: Show On Quotation
Res.FullDescription: Tick this option if you want this charge code to print on Quotation document.

Res.Caption: Don't Show on Quote if Amount is Zero
Res.FullDescription: Tick this option if you don't want this charge code to be included on the Quotation document if the amount is Zero.

Res.Caption: Class
Res.FullDescription: Charge Code Class - Describes the class of the charge code.

Res.Caption: Input Tax Recoverable Percentage
Res.FullDescription: Tax Recoverable Percentage

Res.Caption: Input Tax Recoverable Percentage
Res.FullDescription: Tax Recoverable Percentage

Res.Caption: Is Ad Hoc Service Charge
Res.FullDescription: When enabled, auto-rating will match this charge-code to any Job Services where the Service Code matches this Service Type, and the Rating Adapter uses this Charge Group. Only one Charge Code can be selected for each Company, Charge Group and Service Type combination.

Res.Caption: Disbursement Surplus GL Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account used for posting GL Journal when aggregated disbursement balance is a surplus.

Res.Caption: Disbursement Shortfall GL Account
Res.FullDescription: The GL Account used for posting GL Journal when aggregated disbursement balance is a shortfall.
